notes:
## 0.2.181

owes: **the reader's list stays one stacked list until you click, and a new *Open articles* setting
decides what a click does.** Settings → Interface gains *Open articles* after *Article layout*
(`beside the list`, the default, or `in a new tab`), stored per user in `shell.local_web` as
`articleOpen`; no phone syncs it, no collection and no wire shape changes, and an older record without
the field reads as the default. On a wide window (1 280 px and up) every list page is the centred
stacked list before a click — the empty *Select an article to read it here* column is gone — and an
opened article now sits to the right of the list, the opened row highlighted, without overlapping it;
in the new-tab mode a row opens the article page in a new tab and the list never moves. The reader's
own script (`static/reader-scroll.js`) changed, so its hash changed with it; the four-script CSP is
rebuilt from the shipped bytes and needs nothing from the operator. (specs/SPECReaderOpenMode.md)

owes: **a phone's weather refresh interval and default view now take effect, and the browser's view
choice reaches the phone.** This hub read `weather.settings/refresh_hours` and `view`, names
WeatherScraper never writes; it now reads `refresh_interval_hours` and `forecast_view`
(`NOW`/`SEVEN_DAY`/`FOURTEEN_DAY`, shown as `now`/`7d`/`14d`). A phone that asked for a shorter refresh
interval than the hub's 3 hours now shortens that city's fetch interval (never below the 15-minute
floor), and the place page opens on the phone's view. The `⋮` view control is now three `POST` forms
(`/weather/place/{id}/view`) that write `weather.settings/forecast_view` in the phone's vocabulary,
which the phone pulls on its next sync. A `view` record this hub wrote earlier is still read while no
`forecast_view` record exists, and is never written again. No migration and no new collection; a
rollback leaves `forecast_view` records that the older hub simply does not read.
(specs/SPECAddressStateObserved.md §3.3)

owes: none for the *no address* boards — stocks and weather now name what they observed (this account
holds no address / it was cleared on a date / it is not an absolute http or https address), cite the
`stocks.settings` or `weather.settings` push stamp instead of what a round carried, and offer the
settings form and the phone's *Send everything again*. One banner above the board when the whole board
shares the state, one short line per card. No configuration key, wire shape or default changes.
(specs/SPECAddressStateObserved.md §3.1, §3.2)
